Package com.j3d.engine.interact.selection

Class SelectionManager

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.selection.SelectionManager
public class SelectionManager extends Object
Manages the selection of GObjects within a collection of Layers and Things. Provides functionality to filter and retrieve selected objects based on various criteria.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

    • isNothingSelected

      public boolean isNothingSelected()
      Checks if no GObjects are currently selected.
      Returns:
      true if no GObjects are selected, false otherwise.

    • include

      public SelectionManager include(SelectionManager other)
      Includes the selected GObjects from another SelectionManager into this one.

      Typically used when the SelectionType is SelectionType.INCLUDE.

      Parameters:
      other - The other SelectionManager whose selected GObjects are to be included.
      Returns:
      This SelectionManager instance, allowing for method chaining.

    • exclude

      public SelectionManager exclude(SelectionManager other)
      Excludes the selected GObjects from another SelectionManager from this one.

      Typically used when the SelectionType is SelectionType.EXCLUDE.

      Parameters:
      other - The other SelectionManager whose selected GObjects are to be excluded.
      Returns:
      This SelectionManager instance, allowing for method chaining.

    • filter

      public SelectionManager filter(Predicate<GObject> predicate)
      Filters the currently selected GObjects based on a given predicate.
      Parameters:
      predicate - The predicate to apply for filtering. Objects for which the predicate returns true will be removed.
      Returns:
      This SelectionManager instance, allowing for method chaining.
